claim_text: Annual vehicle-kilometers traveled on the South Quay corridor totaled 1.8 million.
source_text: Northmere Transport Strategy, corridor appendix. The text lists 1.8 million vehicle-kilometers for the South Quay corridor. Vehicle-kilometers are defined as the sum of distances traveled by motor vehicles within the corridor.
